data.name: Bhimarathi
data.gender_notes: Bhimarathi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhimarathi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bhima' meaning 'strong' and 'Rathi' meaning 'chariot'. This name symbolizes the divine chariot of Lord Brahma, the creator of the universe. The name Bhimarathi carries the meaning “Brahma's divine chariot” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhimarathi usually hope their child will grow to embody brahma's divine chariot and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodiment of strength and divine power
data.etymology: Bhimarathi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brahma's divine chariot.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhimarathi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bhimarathi is associated with the legendary character Bhima from the Mahabharata epic. Bhima was the second of the five Pandavas, the heroes of the epic. Known for his strength and courage, Bhima was a loyal brother and friend to his brothers and his wife Draupadi. The name Bhimarathi pay homage to this powerful and charismatic character who continues to inspire and influence Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu mythology, Lord Brahma is considered the creator of the universe. The Chariot of Lord Brahma represents the vehicle of creation and the means by which the universe is brought into existence. The name Bhimarathi is thus a symbol of this divine chariot, reminding us of the power and creative energy that lies within each one of us. It serves as a reminder of our potential to shape our own lives and contribute to the greater good of the universe.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bhimarathi can be considered as the embodiment of strength and wisdom. The prefix 'Bhim' signifies power and courage, while 'Arathi' signifies the one who is devoted to the wisdom of life. It is believed that Bhimarathi possesses the inner strength to overcome challenges, combined with the wisdom to navigate through the complexities of life. Her name is a constant reminder of the power of inner fortitude and the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bhimarathi was a queen of the Satavahana dynasty in the 1st century AD. The name Bhimarathi carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Bhimarathi continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
